headline: Moving $35,000 from investment to checking to pay bills; McGrath Landscaping payment on hold until funds are deposited.
summary: The meeting reviewed the July financial report. The investment balance was $187,560.07 with no income. Monument repairs are to start in Sept–Oct 2026, and many trees need to be removed.
decisions: Moved $35,000 from the investment account to the checking account this week.
Put the McGrath Landscaping payment on hold until funds are deposited.
